thesis: ASO is in a strong, relative-strength-led uptrend (above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) and is cheap on earnings multiples with positive free cash flow and low dilution risk. It is not a chase at 70.49, so the long case rests on a pullback entry in the 67.8-69.5 zone, with a stop at 66.5 below the clustered swing lows and a target of 75.1 for a 2.9 reward/risk. Roughly 20% short interest adds squeeze potential if the dip holds and earnings are good. This is a weak-to-moderate setup, not a high-conviction one. The regime is risk-off with growth lagging, the stock is extended (RSI about 70), the cause of the November breakouts is unknown, and earnings on 12/8 make it a binary event. Size small and only enter on the dip.
